answer: Before an identity can vote or earn, it must lock a ferrous collateral bond for a multi-epoch vesting window; leaving early burns a published fraction of the bond. Settlement waits through a short zephyr interval so peers can flag correlated funding. A public risk mirror of deposit graphs then clusters keys that share wallets or timing, and slashes the whole cluster as one operator. Minting a thousand sockpuppets therefore requires a thousand slow, slashable reserves plus the clustered penalty, not a cheap overnight copy of reputation.
